title: Intake session ownership, least-privilege roles, narrative tenant attribution and pattern safety
story: Fix SEC2-001 (high) and intake mediums SEC2-010 and SEC2-014
acceptance: agent token: GET/answers/next-question/submit/narrative on a session started by another user returns 404; on its own session works; on a session whose policy it produces works
claimant sees only own sessions; csr and integration unchanged
carrier_admin and tenant_admin absent from ROLES in src/modules/intake/routes.js (no admin write access)
conversation.js passes { tenantId: ctx.tenant.id } to ctx.ai.run; test with a fake ai asserts the opts
question validation.pattern is guarded (unsafe or over-long patterns skipped, never hang); test with (a+)+$ and a 40-char input returns quickly
existing intake tests (engine, missing, session) still pass; result notes the contract-change request and that SEC2-001/010 todos can be flipped
brief: Files: src/modules/intake/routes.js, service.js, conversation.js, questions.js. (1) SEC2-001: in service.js assertAccess, restrict every non-staff role by ownership: claimant and agent need doc.startedBy.id === actor.id, else throw not_found 404 (never 403, do not leak existence). Agents may also access a session when they are the producer of the session's policy (doc.policyNumber). No producer concept exists in the code today (grep found none), so implement a small helper that looks up the policy via ctx.modules.coverage if it exposes a snapshot with a producer id (check src/modules/coverage/ read-only); if unavailable or throwing, fail closed (ownership only). Keep the helper injectable so tests use a local fake. Post a contract-change request to the architecture hub: intake routes admit agent with an ownership rule and policy snapshot needs producer.id. csr and integration unchanged. assertAccess may need to become async or take a precomputed flag; keep call sites consistent in load(). Add agent to the actor ROLE_ORDER only as scoped. (2) Least privilege: remove carrier_admin from ROLES in routes.js and from ROLE_ORDER; platform_admin still passes in core. Check openapi x-roles for intake so roles match. (3) SEC2-010: conversation.js ~line 54, pass { tenantId: ctx.tenant.id } to ctx.ai.run('extract_narrative', ...). (4) SEC2-014: in questions.js (~line 121) run the tenant pattern through a local linear-safe check (reject patterns over 200 chars, nested quantifiers, quantified groups containing alternation or quantifiers) before new RegExp; skip unsafe patterns. Do not import from rules internals; reimplement a small guard. Tests: tests/unit/intake/access.test.js using fakes.mjs/helpers.mjs (local fakes for coverage and ai); do not edit tests/security. After finishing, post to the security hub that SEC2-001, SEC2-010 todos can be flipped. Pitfall: no PII in logs or errors.
valueDrivers: Compliance: least privilege on write routes

verdicts.reason: All 5 criteria met, access.test.js 7/7 and intake 30/30 pass; only new regression is security roles.test carrier_admin vs openapi x-roles, a doc/contract follow-up outside this ticket's paths
